text: Karen was a high school student who was doing very poorly in school and hated it. She spent most of her time daydreaming about going to Hawaii. A few weeks before the end of the year Karen was failing enough classes that she was not going to graduate, because she had spent all her study time daydreaming. To encourage Karen, her father promised to take her to Hawaii if she passed all of her classes. Karen was thrilled. However, there was no longer enough time for her to learn the material and pass. Consequently, Karen failed her classes and did not get to go to Hawaii. Karen was deeply disappointed and cried in her room, but she didn't get to go to Hawaii.
